content_feed.telegram_post: 👤 #APPOINTMENT | Dam Capital Advisors Limited (NSE: DAMCAPITAL) Dam Capital Advisors Announces Board Changes ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🔹 Key Details: - New Appointment: Mr. Kishor Purshottam Thakkar - Designation: Independent Director - Tenure: 5 consecutive years, effective from December 14, 2026 to December 13, 2031 - Cessation: Mr. Rajendra Chitale ceases to be Independent Director upon completion of his second term on December 14, 2026 📌 What happened: ↳ The board approved the appointment of Mr. Kishor Purshottam Thakkar as an Independent Director and noted the upcoming cessation of Mr. Rajendra Chitale, alongside approving the standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 Source: NSE Corporate Filing
